title: Bona Fide Freight Dispatcher vs. Unauthorized Broker: Federal Registration and Legal Boundaries
excerpt: How 49 CFR 371.2 and 49 U.S.C. 13102 separate a bona fide agent of a carrier from a broker who must register, and what 49 U.S.C. 14916 provides for unauthorized brokering.
meta_title: Dispatcher vs Broker: Bona Fide Agent Rules
